resources.string: Allows the official stylus to work without Bluetooth and enables support for third-party pens. Also forces the display to operate at 60/120 Hz even when no pen is connected.
Select display refresh rate for stylus mode
Stylus Mode enables pen-compatible refresh rates when a supported stylus is connected. The display switches to 60 Hz or 120 Hz only while the pen is connected.
Smart cover open and close behavior
This toggles the behavior of the smart lid

Enable this only if you own the Xiaomi Smart Keyboard. When enabled, the system will (hopefully) automatically detect keyboard connection and manage power states. Disabling this saves battery and system resources.\n\nNote: This is separate from Bluetooth keyboards, which work without this setting.
Suspend battery input to run directly from the charger
Status: Active — Battery input is suspended
Bypass charging is not supported by the current kernel
When enabled, power flows directly from the charger to the device, bypassing the battery. The battery will not charge while this is active.\n\nThe feature resets automatically on reboot.
Set the maximum refresh rate for a specific application
Control the saturation level of the display
Changing the color mode in display settings will override the saturation level, requiring it to be reapplied.
Boost CPU scheduling for the active app
Not supported by the current kernel
may increase background app kill rate

Raises the CPU scheduling priority of the app currently on screen and, at higher levels, the foreground app stack.

Off — no boost applied (system default).
Low — mild boost to the top app only.
Medium — moderate boost to both the top app and foreground apps.
High — strong boost to the top app and foreground apps. At this level the kernel may reclaim memory from background apps sooner, which can cause apps to reload when you switch back to them.

Values are reapplied automatically after reboot.
Controls how the CPU scales its frequency
Not supported by the current kernel

Smart (schedutil) — Scales CPU frequency based on actual scheduler load. Best balance of performance and battery for everyday use.

Performance — Locks all CPU cores to maximum frequency at all times. Gives the most consistent performance but drains battery faster and runs hotter. Recommended for sustained gaming sessions.

Power Save — Locks all cores to minimum frequency. Significantly reduces battery drain but makes the device feel sluggish. Only useful for very light tasks like reading.

Note: The CPU governor may be temporarily overridden by the system during app launches or touch events. This is normal behaviour.

This setting is reapplied automatically after reboot.
Restore all Performance and Touch settings to their default values
All Performance and Touch & Input settings will be restored to defaults. Accessories, Display and Battery settings are not affected.
